messages:
maria (Marketing): Quick sync — Marketing wants to send the public announcement next Wednesday (2024-07-10). Need final changelog, docs link, and confirmed rollout window by EOD Friday. Also picking webinar slot (AM/PM). @sam @lee @ana

sam (Eng): Wed looks fine from engineering but prefer staged rollout: canary -> global. Proposed times: canary 09:00 PT, global 11:00 PT. Need feature flag names, model list, and any migration notes.

lee (Docs): Docs are ~90% ready. Final API examples pending until changelog lands. I'll publish to /docs/release-2024-07-10 once we have the changelog file. Draft preview: https://redwood.example/docs/drafts/release-2024-07-10 (internal access).

ana (Product): (typo fixed) Ana (Product): Webinar preference: 10:00 PT — targets: devs + platform teams. I put a draft registration page in Notion and a short agenda. Can we lock speaker list?

maria (Marketing): For inbound leads: route webinar regs to sales queue `launch-webinar` and tag with utm=release-jul10. Can someone confirm we can push registrants to SFDC through our Zapier flow? Also need an approved 2-paragraph marketing blurb by Friday noon.

sam (Eng): Zapier->SFDC routing is OK. Feature flag to gate heavy models: `release_jul_10_v1`. Changelog filename: `CHANGELOG/2024-07-10.md` — adding the headline items now. Snippet:```
## 2024-07-10 - Release v2024.07.10
- Added: streaming API with structured events
- Improved: batching and KV cache performance (2.4x throughput for typical workloads)
- Fixed: token accounting edge-case for long prompts
```

lee (Docs): Got the snippet, thanks. I'll fold that into the release notes and add a minimal cURL example. Ping me final model identifiers (quantized vs full-precision) so I can show correct config.

ana (Product): Benchmarks — are the 2.4x throughput and ~30% cost reduction numbers stable across regions? We plan to call these out in the webinar.

sam (Eng): Numbers come from our staging perf runs (seq_len=512, batch=64). They're stable for the models in the catalog we tested. I'll add a small caveat in the public notes about workload-dependent variance and link the perf dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/perf/d/abcd

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary at 2024-07-10T09:00:00-07:00, global at 2024-07-10T11:00:00-07:00. Triggered by release tag `v2024.07.10`.

maria (Marketing): Action items summary: Sam — final changelog + model list by Thu EOD. Lee — publish docs + examples by Fri 10:00 PT. Ana — approve marketing blurb by Fri 12:00 PT. I'll assemble announcement, social copy, and webinar registration page after approvals. Please react here if anything slips. :thumbsup:

sam (Eng): On it.

lee (Docs): Will publish to drafts and update link when live.

ana (Product): 👍

maria (Marketing): Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with a short checklist and the preview page link tomorrow.
